question: The area of a sector of a circle with radius 7 cm and central angle 90° is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A central angle of 90° means the sector is exactly a quarter of the full circle.

Area of a full circle = π × r²

⇒ Full Area = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm²

Area of the sector = 154 ÷ 4 = 38.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 38.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 

 
 r = 7 cm
 90°
 Area of Sector

**Given:**

Radius of the circle (r) = 7 cm

Central angle (θ) = 90°

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × π × r²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (90° ÷ 360°) × (22/7) × 7²

⇒ Area = (1/4) × (22/7) × 49

⇒ Area = (1/4) × 154

⇒ Area = 38.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 38.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Length of an Arc

The length of the arc bounding the sector is given by: *l = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr*.

Perimeter of a Sector

The perimeter of a sector includes the arc length and the two radii forming the sector: *Perimeter = l + 2r*.

Area of a Segment

A segment is the region bounded by a chord and an arc. Its area is: *Area of segment = Area of sector − Area of the corresponding triangle*.
